clauses.quote: Failure at any Level of this procedure to communicate the decision on a grievance within the specified time limits shall permit the aggrieved unit member to proceed to the next level.
clauses.subject_text: Failure at any Level of this procedure to communicate the decision on a grievance within the specified time limits

clauses.quote: Failure at any step of this procedure to appeal a grievance to the next level within the specified time limits shall be deemed as acceptance of the decisions as rendered.
clauses.subject_text: Failure at any step of this procedure to appeal a grievance to the next level within the specified time limits

clauses.quote: All communications, notices, and papers required to be in writing shall be served personally, by U.S. Mail, or through District mail system.
clauses.subject_text: All communications, notices, and papers required to be in writing

clauses.quote: If the alleged grievance is not signed, or if the unit member fails to appear for a scheduled conference without good cause, the grievance shall be deemed forfeited and voided.
Representative(s) may be changed at any level of a grievance.

If the Association is not the representative, the District shall not agree to a resolution of the grievance until the Association has received a copy of the grievance and the proposed resolution and has been given an opportunity to file a response.
Reasonable non-instructional released time for the grievant and representative shall be granted upon request of the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources.
clauses.subject_text: Reasonable non-instructional released time for the grievant and representative

clauses.quote: Under unusual circumstances and/or when necessary to adhere to time lines within this Agreement, instructional time may be granted.
